description: This file defines the `LudoBoard` class, which models the geometry and core positional logic for a classic Ludo game, including track length, safe cells, start offsets for each color, and conversion functions between color-relative progress and global track indices.

classes.name: LudoBoard
classes.description: Immutable class that encapsulates the board geometry, safe cells, start offsets, and conversion logic for a Ludo game.

methods.name: toGlobalTrackIndex
methods.description: Converts a color-relative progress (0..51) on the track to a global track index, considering the start offset for each color.

methods.name: toColorProgress
methods.description: Converts a global track index to a color-relative progress (0..51) if it lies on the specified player's route.

methods.name: isSafeCell
methods.description: Determines whether a given global track index corresponds to a safe cell.
